WITH color_totals AS (
    SELECT p.product_color,
           SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS invoiced_amount
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_color
),
color_shares AS (
    SELECT product_color,
           invoiced_amount,
           invoiced_amount / SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS share_of_total,
           AVG(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS average_per_color
    FROM color_totals
)
SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount,
       AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share,
       AVG(invoiced_amount - average_per_color) AS average_above_per_color_average
FROM color_shares
WHERE invoiced_amount > average_per_color;
